root_cause: The orchestration shell call was given a one-second timeout twice, shorter than the PostgreSQL-backed gate collection's normal startup and execution time.
minimal_reproduction: Invoke the P03-004 candidate gate collection with shell timeout_ms=1000; the shell is terminated with exit code 124 before a product assertion result is available.
excluded_paths: No P03-004 test failure was emitted.
The same complete Agent CI suite passed with a bounded 60-second timeout.
No production database, remote, behavior publication, or formal approval action occurred.
impact: Only the two interrupted orchestration invocations and their incomplete evidence refreshes were affected; implementation and isolated PostgreSQL state remained recoverable.
repair: Use a minimum 60-second shell timeout for gate collections that execute PostgreSQL tests, then run the candidate collection once and validate all bound artifacts.
rollback: No repository rollback is needed; the interrupted commands only touched regenerable local evidence files.
recovery_condition: One candidate-OID gate collection completes with exit code 0 and artifact hashes validate after regeneration.
